parameters.jsCode: const body = $json.body ?? $json; const towers = Array.isArray(body.towers) ? body.towers : []; const score = t => Number(t.healthScore ?? 0); const critical = towers.filter(t => score(t) < 55); const attention = towers.filter(t => score(t) >= 55 && score(t) < 80); const healthy = towers.filter(t => score(t) >= 80); const lines = [`📡 Telecom Tower Report`, `🕒 ${body.generatedAt || new Date().toISOString()}`, `📊 Total: ${towers.length}`, `✅ Healthy: ${healthy.length}`, `⚠️ Attention: ${attention.length}`, `🚨 Critical: ${critical.length}`, '', ...critical.slice(0, 10).map(t => `🚨 ${t.name}: ${score(t)}/100 | ${t.status} | battery ${Math.round(t.batteryLevel ?? 0)}%`)]; return [{ json: { telegramText: lines.join('\\n') } }];
